title: appointments.appointments.reschedule
description: Moves an appointment to another slot. Since appointments#10 the caller says WHEN and, if it wants, for how long — nothing else: the end of the slot is computed by the handler (start + duration), the current duration and the professional come from the appointment's own row, and the move is refused when it lands on a blocked period or breaks the hub's minimum notice / maximum advance. `end_datetime` is gone: an end that did not match its own duration was a row nobody could explain.

duration_minutes.description: Optional. When omitted the appointment keeps the length it already had.
